name: urban-rooftop-leather-girl
image_purpose: Urban rooftop nightlife and fashion social content

prompt.project_info: Create an edgy high-fashion rooftop patio portrait at night with warm bistro lights and a patio heater.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long wavy ginger-auburn hair, fair complexion with light freckles, blue-green eyes, natural makeup and a soft pink lip. She wears a classic black leather biker jacket with silver hardware over a secure black fitted top, a high-waisted black leather mini skirt with vertical seams, and stands with a relaxed hand-on-hip pose near a patio heater.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium waist-up portrait centered near an industrial patio heater with orange flame glow. Include an upscale rooftop patio, woven bistro chairs, small cafe tables, potted greenery, warm string lights and an out-of-focus city skyline with lit skyscrapers.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm cinematic ambient light from the patio heater and bistro bulbs contrasted with a dark night sky and cool city blues, soft bokeh, realistic leather sheen and confident nocturnal atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical fashion portrait, full-frame camera with 50mm lens, medium depth of field, realistic leather and skin texture, subtle warm film grain, natural shadows, no watermark.

She wears a classic black leather biker jacket with silver hardware over a secure black fitted top and a high-waisted black leather mini skirt with vertical seam detailing.
